description: This file contains a Smarty plugin for compiling a modifier called 'count_sentences' which counts the number of sentences in a given text. It defines a function that generates a PHP preg_match_all statement to perform the count using regex.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_count_sentences
methods.description: Generates a PHP preg_match_all call to count sentences in text by matching sentence-ending punctuation.
